versions.changelog: English description and README for ClawHub listing. Multi-language trigger phrases (EN/CN/JP).
Fix: cleaned up __pycache__ binary files that may have triggered false-positive suspicious flag.
Multi-language support: English and Japanese category aliases (food→餐饮, transport→交通, etc.). Users can record expenses in any language.
Auto-init: zero manual setup, database and preset categories created automatically on first use.
Initial release: Natural language accounting, screenshot parsing, budget tracking, weekly/monthly reports, CSV import, local SQLite storage.
